Ancient, Medieval & Art & Culture is becoming harder to ignore in UPSC Prelims and Mains.

In Prelims 2026, 21 out of 100 questions came from Ancient, Medieval, Art & Culture, while GS1 continues to test these areas through challenging Mains questions.

Nikhil Sir explains why AMAC often becomes difficult, where existing preparation falls short, and what a more structured approach should look like. From 40 foundation lectures and 20 years of PYQs to dedicated answer writing, current affairs and performing arts coverage, this AMAC foundation batch is designed for both Prelims and Mains.

Enrollment Open in AMAC Foundation 2027: https://shorturl.at/XXigk 
Call Here: 8826496658

• Prelims + Mains coverage

• Integrated Static + Current approach
